entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your martial training helps you manipulate foes.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13.

Benefit(s): While using this style, you can use your base attack bonus in place of your ranks in Bluff on Bluff checks to feint in combat and to create a distraction to hide. If your Intelligence is at least 19, you gain a +4 bonus on such Bluff checks when adding your Charisma modifier.
